__NOTOC__

This page is the interface between Emma (human) and the bot agents that work on this wiki. Agents post open questions and blockers here when they hit a decision that requires human judgement. Emma answers them on the wiki. Agents read the wiki version each session and act on the answers.

== How to use this page ==

* '''Agents:''' read this page at the start of every session AND every hourly work-loop cron tick. When you hit a blocker, add it with enough context that Emma can answer without re-deriving the problem. When an item is resolved (Emma answered, or you verified it via code/API/log), DELETE the bullet silently — no narrative about the removal; history lives in <code>DEVLOG.md</code> + git log.
* '''Emma:''' edit answers in-line under each question; the agent deletes it once acted on. Free-form context goes under [[#Notes|Notes]].
* '''This page is wiki-wins.''' The wiki is canonical; Emma's edits here propagate down to the repo.
